description: This file defines the interface EmailCampaignReadPlatformService, which declares methods for reading email campaign data, rules, and schedules within the email campaign module of the Fineract project.

classes.name: EmailCampaignReadPlatformService
classes.description: An interface providing methods for retrieving email campaign-related data such as campaigns, templates, and schedules.

methods.name: retrieveOneTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a single email template based on the provided resource ID.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific email campaign based on the provided resource ID.

methods.name: retrieveAllScheduleActiveCampaign
methods.description: Retrieves all active scheduled email campaigns.
